title: eudianthe coeli-rosa var. aspera
intro: Eudianthe coeli-rosa var. aspera, commonly known as the Western Pasque Flower, is a perennial plant native to the western United States. This plant is known for its vibrant purple and white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The Western Pasque Flower is said to have therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues and reducing pain, likely due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and bioactive constituents of Eudianthe coeli-rosa var. aspera.
